name: meta-expert-author
description: Meta-skill for authoring comprehensive flat-prose-entry + tiered-references expert skills via wave-based parallel-agent research-survey. Supports capability mode + canon-curation mode + mixed-mode + micro-skill variants. Covers full lifecycle: invocation flow, scoping survey, wave plan, parallel dispatch, per-wave bookkeeping, publishing trappings, post-v1.0 maintenance, stale-skill recovery, cross-skill dependency management. v1.4 added a prompt-ingestion layer — prompt steelmanning + concept matching — that fires before the four-question gate. v1.5 closes the triad by adding task decomposition as a first-class phase: after ingestion, every ask is decomposed into covering, non-overlapping, individually-tractable sub-asks with explicit ordering. Ingestion + decomposition + execution is now declared as the invocation contract every produced skill inherits. Enforces verification discipline including rot-resistant sourcing. This is the PRACTITIONER-facing authoring job (admits product docs, library readmes, blogs, talks). NOT for a PURELY peer-reviewed-academic theory skill — one paper per reference file, DOI + retraction discipline (meta-theory-author); NOT for standing up a Claude Project knowledge base (plan-knowledge) or mutating one — UPSERT/DEDUPE/RECONCILE (ops-knowledge); NOT for a generic / typed / utility skill (skills-studio) or an apps/ scaffold (meta-app-scaffold).
invariants: Produced skills are answerers, not generators — delegate token/component emission to composing-* and decomposing-* peer skills.
Flat-prose SKILL.md is always the primary entry; references/ loads on demand.
Coverage tiers are declared up-front (foundational / expanded / deep) — no pretence of equal depth.
Every factual claim cites a primary source at file level. Speculation is labeled.
Product-reference profiles document observable public patterns only — no speculative internals.
No fabricated bug IDs, RFC numbers, or commit SHAs in any produced file. If unsure, omit.
Bookkeeping after every wave: INDEX.md flips ⬜→✅, skill.json version bumps, CHANGELOG entry with file table and notable findings.
Never use sed bulk-edits on INDEX.md. Use Write or per-row Edit.
Mode-specific: capability mode uses YAML frontmatter; canon-curation mode accepts inline **Source:** / **Author:** headers.
Mode-specific: below durability-tier 5 (personal blogs, YouTube, corporate press releases), citations require an archive.org mirror alongside the original URL.
Never dispatch the scoping survey on a vague prompt — clear the four-question gate first (domain / mode / release / scale).
Public-release skills require LICENSE + README + MAINTENANCE at minimum; evals/ strongly recommended. Internal skills skip all of these.
Every active skill needs a refresh cadence (default: 6 months); a skill whose most recent `date:` frontmatter is > 12 months old should carry a staleness banner.
Mixed-mode axes declare their mode in INDEX.md; files within an axis follow the axis mode, not the overall skill mode.
Cross-skill file-path references are load-bearing — prefer shallow SKILL.md citations over deep file paths; verify at each 12-month refresh.
Peer-skill refreshes don't propagate automatically — refreshing skill pulls from peers' CHANGELOGs during its own 6-month pass.

Every non-trivial ask passes through ingestion → decomposition → execution before work begins. Skipping any phase corrupts the phases downstream. Produced skills inherit this contract and declare it in their own SKILL.md as an Invocation section.
notes: Exemplars in this skill library: ref-dashboard (101 files, capability), ref-typography (59 files, capability), ref-color (148 files, canon-curation + mixed-mode with techniques/ axis). v1.0 covered the wave arc + bookkeeping. v1.1 added canon-curation mode + rot-resistant sourcing. v1.2 added full lifecycle (invocation flow, publishing trappings, maintenance). v1.3 closed remaining gaps: mixed-mode case study, micro-skill variant, stale-skill-recovery triage, cross-skill dependencies + peer-refresh propagation + shared-vocabulary drift. v1.4 added prompt-ingestion layer (steelmanning + concept-matching). v1.5 added task-decomposition, completing the ingestion → decomposition → execution triad as the invocation contract every produced skill inherits.
